item.title: What If Obi Wan Was Expelled From The Order After His Unauthorized Mission To Mandalore
item.description:
What if Obi-Wan Kenobi was expelled from the Jedi Order after his unauthorized mission to Mandalore? Following the death of Duchess Satine, Obi-Wan finds himself blamed for a devastating political crisis, forcing the Jedi Council to make an impossible decision. Stripped of everything he has spent his life fighting for, Obi-Wan must discover who he truly is without the Order, while Anakin Skywalker struggles with the loss of his former master.

item.title: What If Anakin Burned During The Duel With Dooku In Attack Of The Clones & Became Vader
item.description:
What if Anakin Skywalker was bruned by Count Dooku on Geonosis? With his body broken and his old life seemingly lost, Anakin becomes the subject of a terrifying Sith experiment that could change the course of the galaxy forever. As a mysterious new warrior emerges within the Separatist ranks, the Jedi find themselves facing an enemy unlike anything they have encountered before. And for Obi-Wan Kenobi, the greatest challenge of the war may be one he never could have imagined.

item.title: What If Luke Skywalker Gave In To The Dark Side To Kill Palpatine
item.description:
What if Luke Skywalker gave in to his hatred and killed Emperor Palpatine aboard the Second Death Star? With the Emperor dead and the Empire collapsing, Luke believes he has finally brought peace to the galaxy, but the darkness he embraced refuses to leave him. As he struggles to rebuild the Jedi Order, a mysterious woman from Palpatine's past enters his life, offering guidance through the very darkness he fears. And as Luke grows more powerful, the fate of the Skywalker family may depend on whether he can escape the same path that once destroyed his father.

item.title: What If Qui Gon CHANGED Anakin’s Dreams
item.description:
What if Qui-Gon Jinn changed Anakin Skywalker's nightmares? As the Clone Wars near their end, Darth Sidious begins manipulating Anakin's dreams, hoping to exploit his greatest fears and turn him against the Jedi. But deep within the Living Force, Qui-Gon Jinn senses the darkness surrounding the young Jedi. With the fate of Anakin, the Jedi Order, and the entire Republic hanging in the balance, a single intervention from Qui-Gon could change everything.

item.title: What If Maul Turned To The Light Side When He Found Obi Wan On Tatooine
item.description:
For decades, Maul has lived for one purpose... Revenge against Obi-Wan Kenobi. But when a mysterious encounter with the Force challenges everything he believes, the former Sith begins to question whether vengeance will ever bring him peace. His journey eventually leads him to Tatooine, where a reunion with his oldest enemy takes a turn neither of them could have imagined. And as the galaxy approaches a turning point, the choices of two former enemies could change its destiny forever.

item.description:

With Anakin Skywalker finally turned to the dark side, Palpatine is just moments away from executing Order 66 and destroying the Jedi Order. But after years of careful planning, the Sith Lord is just so tired. Could one unexpected moment change the fate of Anakin Skywalker, the Jedi, and the entire galaxy?

item.title: What If The Jedi Council Never Told Anakin He Was The Chosen One
item.description:
What if Anakin Skywalker was never told he was the Chosen One? What if the Jedi Council kept the prophecy a complete secret, allowing Anakin to grow up without the burden of a destiny he never asked for? With no knowledge of his true potential, Anakin's relationships with the Jedi, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and even Chancellor Palpatine could develop very differently. And as the galaxy descends into the Clone Wars, Anakin's unknown destiny could change the fate of the Jedi, the Sith, and the entire Republic.
